_doc: Schema contract between the HTML app and the Gemini Gem. The app sends geminiRequest, the Gem returns geminiResponse.

geminiRequest._note: The app builds this object from formData + deterministic results, then sends it as the user message to the Gem.

client.name: string
client.vertical: string — E-commerce | Gaming | App | Finance | Beauty | Fashion
client.market: string — US | UK | Germany | France | Spain | Italy | LATAM | APAC
client.regionPack: string — NA | EUI | LATAM | APAC | Global (derived from market)

goals: string — Awareness | Consideration | Conversions | App Installs | Lead Gen | Engagement
scenarios: string — New Product Launch | Geo Expansion | Rebrand | Full Funnel | Seasonal Campaign | Always On
channels: string — existing channels the client uses

challenge.context: string — free-text elaboration from the user

status: string — Has assets | Needs support | No assets | Has creator content
unlockedSupport: string — names of creative support tiers unlocked by budget

eligibility._note: Output of getLiftStudyStatus() — passed verbatim so the Gem can reference it without guessing thresholds.
eligibility.status: string — eligible | potentially_eligible | not_eligible | unknown | consult_ms | standard

deterministic._note: Pre-computed by the app. The Gem should reference these numbers, NOT invent its own.
adFormats: string — recommended formats for selected goals

geminiResponse._note: The Gem returns this JSON object. Each key maps to one output tab in the app. The app renders them directly.

pitch._why: Narrative persuasion benefits most from AI customization. Current version is template-based.
pitch.headline: string — one-line hook, e.g. 'Unlock Gen Z for [ClientName] on TikTok'
pitch.opportunity: string — 2-3 sentences on why this client + TikTok is a fit, referencing vertical + market
pitch.challengeResponse: string — 2-3 sentences addressing the specific challenge, citing TikTok data/capabilities
whyNow: string — 3-5 bullet points, each referencing a real stat or platform capability
pitch.solution: string — 2-3 sentences describing the recommended approach, referencing budget + formats + timeline
expectedOutcomes: string — 3-5 bullet points tied to their specific goals

funnel._owner: HYBRID — app computes splits/budgets, Gem adds strategy narrative
funnel._appComputes: budgetSplit percentages, dollar amounts per tier, audience strategy structure
funnel.upperFunnelStrategy: string — 2-3 sentences on awareness approach tailored to vertical + goals
funnel.midFunnelStrategy: string — 2-3 sentences on consideration tactics for this audience
funnel.lowerFunnelStrategy: string — 2-3 sentences on conversion approach for this vertical
funnel.audienceInsight: string — 1-2 sentences of audience-specific insight beyond the standard retargeting list
testingRecommendations: string — 3-4 bullet points on what to test, specific to vertical + creative status

mediaPlan._owner: HYBRID — app computes flight schedule/budgets, Gem adds format rationale
mediaPlan._appComputes: flight schedule, weekly budgets, format list, placement strategy, bidding strategy

formatRationale._note: One entry per recommended ad format. Key = format name.

<FormatName>.whyThisClient: string — 1-2 sentences on why this format specifically suits this client
<FormatName>.creativeTip: string — 1 sentence practical tip for this format + vertical

phaseGuidance.launch: string — 1-2 sentences on what to prioritize in weeks 1-2 for this vertical

bestPractices._why: Currently uses static lists. Gem can cross-reference playbooks to give tailored advice.

verticalTips.title: string — e.g. 'E-commerce on TikTok'
tips: string — 5-7 actionable tips from the vertical playbook, customized to this client's product/audience

<GoalName>: string — 4-6 actionable tips specific to this goal + vertical combination

universalTips: string — 3-5 platform-wide tips most relevant to this client's situation
avoidList: string — 2-3 common mistakes for this vertical/goal to watch out for

creativeStrategy._why: Current version just lists unlocked tiers. Gem can recommend actual creative approaches.
creativeStrategy.creativeDirection: string — 2-3 sentences on overall creative approach for this brand/vertical

contentPillars.description: string — 1 sentence on what this pillar looks like

formatRecommendations.usage: string — 1 sentence on how to use this format for their creative status

creativeStrategy.creatorGuidance: string — 1-2 sentences on creator strategy based on creative status + vertical

tabOwnership._note: Summary of which output tabs are owned by whom.
tabOwnership.funnel: HYBRID — app: numbers, Gem: strategy text
tabOwnership.mediaPlan: HYBRID — app: schedule/budget, Gem: format rationale + phase guidance
tabOwnership.creativeSupport: HYBRID — app: tier unlocks, Gem: creative strategy (new section)
tabOwnership.bestPractices: GEM — full replacement of static lists

gemRules: NEVER invent threshold numbers (minSpend, minUniqueReach, budget splits). Use ONLY values from deterministic.
NEVER reference incentive tiers the client hasn't unlocked.
ALWAYS use the client's actual product name, not generic placeholders.
ALWAYS reference the specific vertical — do not give generic advice.
If measurement.eligibility.status is 'not_eligible', do NOT promise lift study results in the pitch.
Keep each string field under 280 characters unless marked otherwise.
Return valid JSON only. No markdown, no backticks, no preamble.
